# CampusFind

CampusFind is an academic lost-and-found registry built specifically for SFIT students. It helps students report, track, and recover lost items on campus.

## Overview
- **Purpose**: A centralized platform for reporting and finding lost items.
- **Key Features**: Browse lost/found items, post new items, user dashboard for managing reported items.

## Important Links
- **Home**: https://campusfind.vercel.app/
- **Browse Items**: https://campusfind.vercel.app/items
- **FAQ**: https://campusfind.vercel.app/faq
- **Privacy Policy**: https://campusfind.vercel.app/privacy
- **Terms of Service**: https://campusfind.vercel.app/terms

## Usage Guidelines
Students can log in to report found items or search for things they've lost. The platform uses Supabase for real-time updates and notifications. Private routes (like user dashboards and posting items) require authentication and are not publicly indexed.
